name: Great Viper
description: The great viper is a large, highly venomous snake known for its lethal bite and fast, agile movements. It is adept at ambushing prey and can thrive in a variety of warm environments.

actions.name: Strike
actions.description: The great viper lunges forward and uses its fangs to pierce a creature dealing physical damage. On a true hit, if the targeted creature takes physical damage after mitigation, they gain the poisoned condition for up to 1 minute which deals 1d6 poison damage.

actions.name: Constriction Coil
actions.description: The great viper makes a special grapple check against a creature. If the target of this action botches the check, the grapple prevents creatures who rely on air from breathing, muting them until they escape.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: The great viper tightens its grip on a creature it has grappled causing the creature to take 1d4 true damage and suffer a penalty to their next check to escape the grapple before the end of their next turn equal to the amount taken.

traits.name: Efficient Grappling
traits.description: The great viper can grapple creatures that are one size larger than it.
